description: Template file generating impact data visualizations and modals for project footprints, including impact metrics and impact items.

classes.name: ImpactData
classes.description: Holds impact data attributes such as icon, title, and data unit.

classes.name: ImpactDataProject
classes.description: Represents impact data associated with a project footprint, providing impact data, estimation amount, and data.

classes.name: ImpactProjectItem
classes.description: Represents individual impact items with methods to retrieve name, value, and cost amounts.

methods.name: getImpactData
methods.description: Retrieves impact data object associated with impact data project.

methods.name: getEstimationAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the estimated impact amount for the project impact data.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with impact data project.

methods.name: getImpactItem
methods.description: Retrieves impact item object associated with impact project item.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an impact project item.

methods.name: getCostAmounts
methods.description: Retrieves the cost amounts for an impact project item.
